key_events_next_24h.name: Weekend low-liquidity session (no major macro events scheduled today, Sunday Aug 9)
Upcoming: US July CPI Release (outside 24h window, key Fed input)

market_summary.trend: BTC ~$64,904 as of Aug 9 00:06 UTC (Crypto.com BTCUSD-PERP). 24h range tight: $64,774-$65,151. Consolidating after July 7-day gain of +3.6%. No directional momentum - sideways compression on Sunday.
market_summary.sentiment: Fear & Greed Index 29 (Fear). Retail sentiment bearish but institutional flows constructive. Spot BTC ETFs recorded 6 consecutive days of net inflows (BlackRock IBIT $111M on Aug 3). Goldman Sachs filed for new Bitcoin ETF. Whale accumulation ongoing. Overall: cautious but with underlying institutional support.
market_summary.macro: FOMC held at 3.50%-3.75% on Jul 29 (9-3 vote, most divided since 2016). July NFP badly missed (-23K actual vs +80K expected), unemployment 4.1%. Dovish lean from jobs data reduces rate-hike probability for Sep 15-16 FOMC. Next critical data: CPI Jul on Aug 12, PPI on Aug 13, FOMC minutes Aug 19. Strait of Hormuz negotiations ongoing (Iran), reducing oil/geopolitical risk.
market_summary.catalysts_positive: Weak NFP raises rate-cut/hold prospects. ETF inflows structurally supportive (6-day streak). Goldman Sachs Bitcoin ETF filing ongoing. Fed 9-3 vote signals internal dovish drift. Oil prices lower on Hormuz talks. BTC W-pattern on 4h forming, RSI improving. 7-day gain +3.6%.
market_summary.catalysts_negative: F&G index 29 (Fear zone). $65,000 resistance holding multiple attempts. Digital Asset CLARITY Act stalled in Senate. August historically weak seasonality for BTC. Weekend thin liquidity increases volatility risk. CPI Aug 12 outcome uncertain (could re-price Fed path).
